title: fix(app-shell): Recently Accessed stores identity and labels each item at render; an unchanged list writes nothing (objectui#11678)
body:
Fixes #11678
Clause-②: yes (narrowing)

"Recently Accessed" stored a label the route tracker made from the route's machine name at visit time (`titleize`: the Delivery Operations dashboard was listed as "Showcase Ops Dashboard"), froze it in the visit's language, and saved the list again on every visit to the item already at its head. This PR makes a recent entry store identity, labels it when it is rendered, and makes "no change, no write" a property of the store.

## What changed

**Identity, not text.** `useTrackRouteAsRecent` records an object, dashboard, page or report as `{ id, type, name, href }`; `titleize` is gone. `RecentItem` is now `RecentNamedItem | RecentTextItem`: the four named kinds carry `name` and no `label`; `record` and `metadata` entries keep a `label` (a record's title, which is data and has no metadata label to resolve; a Studio metadata item's name). The kinds are declared once as `RecentItemType`.

**Labelled at render, by the resolvers the console already has.** New `useRecentItemLabel()` holds no labelling rule of its own: an object or a dashboard asks `useNavTargetLabel` (what the sidebar shows for an unlabelled nav entry opening the same target); a page or a report reads its cached metadata label through `useObjectLabel`'s `pageLabel` / `reportLabel`, using the same two helpers `useNavTargetLabel` uses (`metadataText`, `findByName`, now exported from that module). No label anywhere: the machine name, which is the navigation renderer's own backstop. Every surface that rendered the stored `label` now asks it: the /home rail (`HomeContinue`, which `HomePage` hands the resolver as `labelOf`, the way it hands `t`), the `RecentApps` cards, the sidebar's Recent group, Studio home, and the command palette's recent records. `useRecentItemLabel` is exported from the entry from its own module; the `useRecentItems` shim stays hooks and types only.

**No change, no write, at the store.** `RecentItemsProvider` decides writes from a ref outside any state updater (the old code wrote inside a `setState` updater, which React may run more than once), and `commit` refuses a list equal to the one it holds: no state change, no localStorage write, no `adapter.save()`, so no `sys_user_preference` PATCH. `addRecentItem` is a no-op when the head entry already has the same content, so a revisit no longer stamps a fresher `visitedAt` (the head's `visitedAt` is when it became the most recent entry). A head whose content changed, such as a record title that resolved after the first add, is still written.

**Lists already stored.** Legacy entries carry their identity in `id` (`TYPE:NAME`, the only id the tracker ever wrote for the four named kinds), so the reader takes the name from there and drops the minted label; it is not used as a fallback. Reading a legacy list writes nothing back; the next real change writes the identity shape.

**Gate entry repointed.** `check:i18n-keys` read the `home.recentApps.itemType.*` members off the `type` field of `interface RecentItem`, which is now a union it cannot parse; its family entry in `scripts/check-i18n-call-site-keys.mjs` now names the `RecentItemType` union (114 member keys checked exactly, the same six recent kinds as before).

## Measured before building (the order's Zone 2)

1. Confirmed on `da35453`: the tracker minted the label with `titleize` at visit time, the provider persisted it, `RecentApps` rendered the stored string. Probe reading of a dashboard visit's saved row at the base: `"label":"Showcase Ops Dashboard"`; at this head: `"type":"dashboard","name":"showcase_ops_dashboard"` and no label.
2. The double write. A jsdom probe (real `RecentItemsProvider`, real tracker, real `createObjectStackUserStateAdapter` over a counting data source; not committed) counted `update` calls, base vs head:

| scenario | base | head |
|---|---|---|
| one visit | 1 | 1 |
| leave, then come back to the item at the head | 2 | 1 |
| an object's list route, then one of its view routes | 2 | 1 |
| the tracker remounted on the same route | 2 | 1 |
| one visit under StrictMode | 1 | 1 |
| `appName` resolving after the pathname | 1 | 1 |

StrictMode is not the source. Every re-report of the identity already at the head wrote again at the base, and the store now refuses all of them. NOT MEASURED: which navigation produced the second PATCH in the triage's live session — this container has no backend to run (the sibling objectstack checkout is neither installed nor built), so no browser reading was taken.

3. Legacy entries: the order assumed the reader would fall back to the stored text; measured instead that the identity is in `id`, so no fallback to the minted text is needed (pinned).
4. Resolvers reused, as above; no second labelling rule.
5. Built declarations (`packages/app-shell/dist/context/RecentItemsProvider.d.ts`): `RecentItem` went from one interface with a required `label` to the union above; `addRecentItem` takes `RecentItemInput`. Six new entry exports: `useRecentItemLabel`, `RecentItemLabelResolver`, `RecentItemInput`, `RecentItemType`, `RecentNamedItem`, `RecentTextItem`. Measured arm: **yes (narrowing)** — the entry widens, and `addRecentItem` refuses the label-carrying shape it took for the four named kinds. Reverse check against the built `.d.ts`: a probe compiled with tsc refuses a `label` on a dashboard input (TS2353), refuses the old input with no `name` (TS2353), and refuses `item.label` on an unnarrowed entry (TS2339); the identity-shape and record controls compile.

## Files beyond the claim's surface

The claim named `RecentApps` as the renderer; /home actually renders `HomeContinue`, and `RecentApps` is rendered by no page today. Four more render sites read the stored `label` and had to move with the shape, or they would have rendered blank: `console/home/HomeRail.tsx`, `layout/UnifiedSidebar.tsx`, `views/metadata-admin/StudioHomePage.tsx`, `chrome/CommandPalette.tsx`. Also: `hooks/useRecentItemLabel.ts` (new), `hooks/useNavTargetLabel.ts` (two helpers exported), `index.ts` (exports), `console/home/HomePage.tsx` (passes the resolver to the rail; patch round 1), the package README and `content/docs/guide/user-state-persistence.md` (AGENTS.md rule 2, docs-driven), `scripts/check-i18n-call-site-keys.mjs` (the family entry above), and two existing test fixtures whose entries were label-carrying (`HomeItemTypeLabel.parity.test.tsx`, `StudioHomePage.displayLocale-10232.test.tsx`). No serial-constraint check was run on these by this dev; that read is the seat's.

## Behaviour to know

- Home now reads the dashboard, page and report metadata lists lazily when the recent list holds such an entry: one cached list request per type, as the sidebar already does. Before a type's list arrives the entry shows its machine name.
- In the showcase today, the dashboard and the two pages carry no zh-CN label translation (the showcase bundle translates their nav entries, not the items), so under 中文 they show their own English labels, which is what their own pages show.

## Patch round 1: the import graph (CI run 37455366245 on `ec51ed9`)

Five `RecordDetailView.*` suites failed with `ReferenceError: Cannot access 'authFetchSpy' before initialization`. The `useRecentItems` shim re-exported `useRecentItemLabel`, which reaches `MetadataProvider` and through it `metadataClientFactory`, whose module load calls `createAuthenticatedFetch()`; so `RecordDetailView`, which only wants the list, newly loaded that call before those suites' `@object-ui/auth` mock spy was initialised. Reproduced locally at `ec51ed9`: 5 files failed, the same `ReferenceError` five times.

- The shim is hooks and types again; the entry exports `useRecentItemLabel` and `RecentItemLabelResolver` from `./hooks/useRecentItemLabel.js`.
- `HomeContinue` takes the resolver as a `labelOf` prop from `HomePage`, so `HomeRail.tsx`, which also holds the action center and the activity card, does not load the metadata cache either. `HomePage` already loaded it on `main`.
- Measured with a static runtime-import walk over `packages/app-shell/src` (type-only imports and dynamic `import()` excluded), `main` (`abd374b`) against the merged head: `RecordDetailView`, `ObjectView`, the five suites and `HomeRail.tsx` reached `MetadataProvider` before the fix and do not after it. What reaches it newly is only the resolver itself, the two surfaces that render with it (`RecentApps`, `StudioHomePage`, the latter already loading `metadataClientFactory` on `main`), Studio's lazily imported barrel, and their own tests. Controls: `UnifiedSidebar` and `HomePage` reach it in every tree; `RecordDetailView` does not on `main` and did before the fix, which is the CI reading.
- ⛔ No suite or mock was edited to get green, none is skipped.
- `main` (`abd374b`) is merged in with a merge commit; no rebase, no force-push.

## Tests

At head `0c8198b`, through the shared verify lock:

- The five suites: red at `ec51ed9` (5 files failed, `ReferenceError` ×5), green at `0c8198b` (5 files, 24 tests passed).
- The whole app-shell suite, `pnpm exec vitest run packages/app-shell/`: exit 0, 1031 files passed and 1 skipped (1032), 10165 tests passed and 9 skipped. It covers every file that references `authFetchSpy` or mocks `@object-ui/auth` there (216) and round one's 34-file union.
- New pins: `RecentApps.labelAtRender-11678.test.tsx` (the three measured pages in en, then zh-CN over the same stored entries, on both the /home rail wired as `HomePage` wires it and the `RecentApps` cards — served dashboard label, client bundle page label, and an untranslated page showing its own label; a legacy list shows current labels, never the minted text; an unloaded type shows the machine name); `useTrackRouteAsRecent.test.tsx` "revisiting the most recent item makes no write", list route then view route saved once, and a control that does write; `RecentItemsProvider.test.tsx` head re-add writes nothing, clearing an empty list writes nothing, a changed head is written, and the legacy read from localStorage and from the adapter.
- Ablations (round one, at `ec51ed9`; the store and resolver code they mutate did not change this round), each with the fix committed first, the mutation proven on disk and restored to the HEAD blob with an empty `git diff HEAD` (`ablation-replace.mjs`): removing the head no-op turned exactly the three head-revisit pins red; removing the store's equality guard turned exactly the empty-clear pin red (the head pins stay green, held by the head no-op, as predicted); short-circuiting the page label to the machine name turned both label pins red.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell type-check` (src and `tsconfig.test.json`, which includes every test file), `build` (dist completeness verified) and `lint` (0 errors): exit 0 each. The built entry exports `useRecentItemLabel` from `./hooks/useRecentItemLabel.js`, and the shim's declaration no longer names it. Reverse type check against the rebuilt `.d.ts`: the same three refusals (TS2353, TS2353, TS2339), controls compile.
- The edited gate script's own suites (round one, at `ec51ed9`; the script is unchanged since): 8 files, 493 tests passed.

## Gates (not under the lock, head `0c8198b`)

`check-i18n-call-site-keys` 0 · `check-readme-exports` 0 · `check-doc-snippet-types` 0 (after building its `--build-filter` closure) · `check-changeset-presence` 0 · `check-changeset-no-major` 0 · `check-changeset-overwrite` 0 · `check-changeset-claims` 0 (report-only; it names `.changeset/11659-console-record-ux.md`, whose `RecoveryPasswordReminder` paragraph names `HomePage.tsx` — still true against this diff, which leaves the reminder's import and its two render sites untouched) · `check-pending-changeset-literals` 0 · `check-new-cross-file-line-citations` 0 (0 new) · `check-control-bytes` 0 · `check-doc-links` 0 · `check-doc-component-types` 0 · `check-doc-fence-languages` 0 · `check-doc-example-ids` 0 · `check-vi-mock-specifiers` 0 · `check-vi-mock-inherit` 0 · `check-unreferenced-sources` 0 · `check-test-path-roots` 0 · `check-spec-symbol-derivation` 0 · `check-package-self-import` 0 · `check-phantom-dependencies` 0. Repo-wide lint is CI's. `@object-ui/console` type-check not run: no console source names a recent-items symbol.

## Acceptance notes

- Cold-landing race, untouched here: a visit recorded before the adapter's `load()` resolves is overwritten by hydration (probe: 0 writes, entry gone, at the base and at this head alike). Measured only in jsdom, not at a console door; carrier: none.
- Dashboard label precedence: `useNavTargetLabel` (and so this list and the sidebar) runs a served dashboard label through the client bundle, while the dashboard page header draws the served label as given (objectui#11295). They differ only when a dashboard has both a published label edit and a bundle key. Read-only inference, not measured; carrier: none.
- `RecentItemsProvider` still keys its debounced flusher effect on a `useMemo` identity (AGENTS.md rule 10); pre-existing and not changed here.
